title: Start-up of plane Couette flow: the wall-stress excess against Lambda / l, and the profiles
caption: The start-up of plane Couette flow (gap H = 20 l, the lower wall set impulsively in motion at U, w = 0 on both walls, K = 3) as a test of the saturation of the wall-stress excess. (a) E = tau_mp / tau_N - 1 on the sliding wall against Lambda / l, Lambda = (mu + kappa / 2) U / tau_N of the Newtonian fluid mu + kappa / 2 (for the Rayleigh layer sqrt(pi nu_inf t)): the host solution (implicit, stretched grid, converged to 3e-5 in E) for j = l^2, l^2 / 100 and l^2 / 10^4 (the quasi-steady limit), the runs (l = 20, 40, 80 dx, j = l^2; l = 40 dx with j = l^2 / 100, drawn to Lambda = 4 l, beyond which that pair at its 21 times smaller dt drifts, its control as well; lines: the wall form, open markers: the 4 dx fit; both from Lambda = 2 dx) with the floor of l = 20 dx (repeat, half Mach; grey), the early limit sqrt(1.6) - 1 (a layer thinner than l is a Newtonian layer of viscosity mu + kappa) and the steady value of eq. 5.5 (star). Crosses: the peak wall-stress excess of the dipole-wall collision runs (tables 22, 26, 29: Re = 625 and 1250, W / dx = 500 to 2000, the normal and the oblique collision) at their Lambda / l - another flow, whose outer flow changes with l. (b, c) u and w across the gap at Lambda = 0.25 l, l and 4 l: the run at l = 40 dx (markers) against the host solution (lines).
tag: v10-periodic (thesis-ch5-rc2 + the periodic domain of Stage 8b)
